name: Timers
description: Named deadlines on the instance, each due a time after it starts: at the create, each time the status of the type's Workflow enters a state, or at the time a date-time field of the instance holds, before it with a negative offset. A due deadline fires once: it is marked fired and can move the status, from the state it starts in unless the config names others, whatever the move meets. A change of the status can cancel a pending deadline, and a field deadline moves with its field. The engine's runner fires the due deadlines every sweepMs; a caller with the config's permission resets or snoozes one. A deadline that names a state needs Workflow on the type.

afterMs.description: How long after its start the deadline is due, in milliseconds; 0 when absent. Negative, before its start, for a field start alone.

start.description: What the deadline starts from: the instance's create ({ create: true }), each entry of the status into a state of the type's Workflow ({ enters }), or the time an own date-time field holds ({ field }), which moves the deadline when it changes and cancels it when it is cleared.

enters.description: A state of the type's Workflow; the deadline starts again at each entry into it.

field.description: An own field of the type, by JSON key, whose values are date-times.

then.description: Moves the status of the type's Workflow, through its transition, when the deadline fires while the status is one of from.

from.description: The states the status moves from; in any other it stays. When absent, the state the deadline starts in: its enters state, or the Workflow's initial state for a create start. A field start names them.

until.description: Cancels the deadline while it is pending once a change leaves the status out of the state it starts in ({ leaves }) or in one of the states given ({ enters }). Needs Workflow on the type.

leaves.description: The state the deadline starts in: its enters state, or the Workflow's initial state for a create start.

enters.description: States of the type's Workflow, none of them the state the deadline starts in.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to reset or snooze a deadline; nobody may when absent.

sweepMs.description: How often the engine's runner fires the due deadlines, in milliseconds; 5000 when absent.

fields.name: deadlines
fields.description: Each started deadline, by name: { dueAt, fired, firedAt?, outcome? }, when it is due, in epoch milliseconds, whether it has fired and when, and what its then met: moved, skipped (the status was not one it moves from), vetoed or forbidden. A deadline not started, or cancelled, is absent. Nothing in it follows the clock: a deadline is overdue while it has not fired and its dueAt has passed.

operations.name: fireTimer
operations.description: Fires a deadline that is due and has not fired: marks it fired and moves the status by its then, recording the outcome; a veto or a missing permission the move meets leaves the status as it is and the deadline fired. A deadline whose until holds is cancelled instead. On a deadline not due, fired already or not started it changes nothing. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; the engine's runner calls it on every due deadline, every sweepMs.

fired.description: Whether this call fired the deadline.

outcome.description: When it fired a deadline with then: what the move met.

operations.name: resetTimer
operations.description: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.

operations.name: snoozeTimer
operations.description: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.
When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.

vetoes.description: fireTimer, resetTimer or snoozeTimer of a deadline the config does not name.

resetTimer of a deadline with nothing to start from now (an enters deadline while the status is in another state, a field deadline whose field holds no date-time), or snoozeTimer of one not started or cancelled; either of a deadline whose until holds.
